schema.description: One record per playable video in the rebuilt EduTube catalogue.

fields.title: Current YouTube title (oEmbed), falling back to the 2008-2021 archive title
fields.duration: mm:ss exactly as the archive listed it; `dur` is seconds
fields.thumb: Thumbnail URL; 50%-of-video frame where available (maxres2/sd2/hq2), uploaded art otherwise
fields.subject: The judge's subject classification (14 values)
fields.level: The judge's educational-level classification: Pre-school | Primary | Secondary | University | General
fields.classroom: Probability (0-1) that a teacher can play it in K-12 without caveats
fields.evergreen: Probability (0-1) that it is still teaching material, not a dated artifact
fields.promotional: Probability (0-1) that the clip is an advertisement or promotional video; >=0.60 was dropped as spam
fields.index: EduTube editorial index (0-10); 0.0 means the editors scored it zero
fields.views_day: Views per day as recorded by EduTube before 2021
fields.archived: Year of the Wayback capture the record came from
fields.judged: True if the judge scored this record (vs. metadata-only fallback)
fields.slug: EduTube archive slug for the video page
fields.channel_url: YouTube channel URL from oEmbed, empty if unresolved
fields.live: True if oEmbed confirmed the video is still playable at build time

provenance.catalogue: EduTube.org 2008-2021, via the Internet Archive (web.archive.org CDX + /en/category/* tables)
provenance.judgments: Typed judgments from a language model: subject, level, classroom_ok, evergreen, promotional intent
provenance.rights: Videos belong to their channels and stream from YouTube; nothing is re-hosted
provenance.rebuild: pipeline/ in this repo: harvest_listing.py -> enrich.py -> thumbs.py -> judge.py -> build_catalog.py
